stage1.impression: A clean, competent night-bar render that reads as CG at first glance rather than a photograph: the slatted wall is flat, evenly lit and textureless at 1:1, the lit band under the ceiling reads as a salmon-pink corrugated plastic light box, and the props (identical stools, bottles and tables) repeat. The low-key mood, pools of light and warm grade are right, but nothing in the frame says 'this specific place'. It reads as a generic hospitality bar, not one a design magazine would run as a specific, well-made room.

blocking_9: The lantern's band must read as thick amber cast acrylic with glowing fin edges, not a pink light box: band region [270,172,910,250] clip_pct < 0.5 and b_median well below g_median (amber, not salmon)

The slotted oak baffle must stop being the brightest flat surface in the frame: lum_median about 70 to 95 in [300,330,600,500], with visible grain, board-to-board tone variation and a natural top-to-bottom falloff
Visible sign of life and specificity: records, a sleeve, coats, half-full glasses, variation in the bottles; no row of five identical stools reading as copies
The right-hand plaster wall and ceiling must hold detail instead of reading as an empty void (right wall [940,100,1200,520] lum_median >= 26)

The EARF product (the Tropos pair or Mother EARF) as the frame's single saturated colour, read at a glance; right now no speaker reads in the frame and the band's pink and the banquette's red are the only colour

defects.what: Lit acrylic band reads salmon pink (RGB median 247/181/164), 5.1% clipped, with a fine regular vertical-line pattern like corrugated polycarbonate or a signage light box; no thickness, no glowing polished edges
Slotted oak baffle is the brightest surface in the room (lum_median 146), flat and uniform, with no grain, no oil sheen and no slat-to-slat variation: a CG material at 1:1
A hard hot spot from a point source right under the band on the baffle; it reads as a stray fixture, not a designed graze
Row of black notches along the porch's top edge reads as a texture or geometry artifact, not a detail
Five identical stools at identical spacing: obvious repeated copies
Back-bar bottles are a few repeated models with identical fill and labels; the shelf LED lines are thin white strips that read as retail display
Terrazzo bar face has large, multicoloured confetti chips that read busy and a little like a placeholder texture; the quartzite top is a flat dark slab with no veining or reflection
Four identical tables with near-identical glasses, laid out like a showroom; no coats, no records, no sign of use
Banquette leather is a saturated oxblood that reads as plastic and competes with the hero colour; the oak cap shows a repeated grain texture
Right plaster wall is a near-empty dark plane (lum_median 19); no grazing light, no texture, so the room reads as a void on the right
Ceiling is an undifferentiated dark field (lum_median 13); the downlights read as dots with no visible fitting or pool
The three pendants are generic white domes; their light falls on nothing in particular and they do not read as EARF Hemispheres in a tint

changes.problem: The lantern's band is the image's signature and reads as a pink, clipped light box rather than amber cast acrylic.

evidence.measured: lum_median 193.7, clip_pct 5.06, RGB median 247/181/164, delta_e2000 22.1 against amber #E08A2E

change.setting: the lantern's band emission and render white_balance_tint
change.to: emission 1.6 with the emitter colour warmed to about 2200 K amber; white_balance_tint 0.0; light the fins' polished bottom edges by putting the emitter behind the fin roots so the edges glow brighter than the faces

changes.expected: The band reads as warm amber with depth between the fins and bright edges, not blown, and the magenta cast leaves the whole frame

changes.problem: The baffle graze makes the slotted oak the brightest, flattest surface, which flattens the depth and pulls the eye away from the band and the counter.

evidence.measured: lum_median 145.6, higher than the back bar (84) and the counter (27)

change.to: 0.6 W/m2, aimed from the foot line upward so it falls off toward the band; remove or dim the point source causing the hot spot under the band at about (568, 245)

changes.expected: The baffle sits mid-tone, with grazing shows the slots and a soft gradient, and the band and counter pools read as the brightest things

changes.problem: The oak (baffle, porch, banquette cap) reads as a smooth CG surface with no grain or board variation.

evidence.measured: seen at 1:1: uniform slats, lum_range 77 only from the light gradient, no grain or sheen

change.to: oiled white oak with visible rift grain at real scale, ±8% tone and ±10% roughness variation per board, a soft satin sheen (roughness about 0.45), and slightly darker end grain at the slot edges; break the repeated texture on the banquette cap

changes.expected: At 1:1 the slats read as individual oak boards; the porch shows slight board-to-board variation

changes.problem: The room is a showroom: repeated stools, bottles and tables, with no sign of life, so it reads as a generic bar.

evidence.measured: seen: five identical stools in an exact row, four identical tables each with one glass, repeated bottle models

change.from: one glass per table, identical bottles
change.to: a record out of its sleeve and a sleeve leaning on the counter, two stools turned a few degrees off-axis, a coat over the banquette, half-full glasses and a carafe at different heights, a mix of at least six bottle shapes and fill levels on the back bar

changes.expected: The frame reads as a room in use, minutes before or after the music, specific to a listening bar

changes.problem: The right plaster wall and ceiling fall into an empty void, so the room loses its edges and reads as a dark box.

change.setting: the banquette spots and the fill
change.from: 4 x spot 9.0 W, 16.0 deg; fill 0.02 W/m2
change.to: 4 x spot 12.0 W, 24.0 deg aimed so each pool washes the plaster above the banquette back; fill 0.04 W/m2

changes.expected: Scalloped pools of light on the lime plaster above the banquette show its texture, and the ceiling holds faint detail

changes.problem: The terrazzo bar face is a busy, multicoloured confetti that reads as a placeholder texture, and the quartzite top is a featureless dark slab.

evidence.measured: seen at 1:1: chips of about 1 to 2 cm in saturated reds and blues; top with no veining or reflection

change.setting: the terrazzo's chip size and ground tone; quartzite finish
change.from: large mixed-colour chips on a dark ground
change.to: 5 to 10 mm chips in warm grey, white and ochre on a mid-grey ground, honed (roughness about 0.5); quartzite with soft linear veining and a faint honed reflection of the pendants

changes.expected: The counter reads as stone and terrazzo of real scale, quieter, and leaves colour to the hero

changes.problem: The banquette leather is a saturated oxblood that reads as plastic and is a second strong colour in a frame that should have one.

evidence.measured: RGB median 45/22/15, a strong red cast against the neutral room

change.setting: the leather's finish within its kind
change.to: dark tobacco brown leather, saturation down about 40%, roughness about 0.55 with creasing and wear on the seat edge

changes.expected: The banquette sits in the room's brown-black range and reads as worn leather

changes.problem: The shelf and back-bar LED lines are thin, cold white strips that read as retail display.

evidence.measured: seen: hard white lines along each shelf front, near-clipped

change.to: 3.5 at 2400 K, recessed under the shelf lip so the line itself is hidden and only the bottles are backlit

changes.expected: The bottles glow amber from below and the shelves read as a warm back bar

out_of_scope.request: Bring the Tropos pair or Mother EARF into view so the frame has its one saturated hero colour
out_of_scope.why: The products are fixed as placed and sit inside the lantern; showing them needs a different camera or opening the porch, which changes the frame's purpose. As composed, this frame has no speaker in it, so the 'one colour, the speaker as hero' test cannot pass.

out_of_scope.request: Make the pendants recognisable as tinted EARF Hemispheres
out_of_scope.why: The products' colour and parts are fixed; they currently read as generic white domes.

out_of_scope.request: Rethink the band's fin profile so it reads as thick cast acrylic, not corrugated sheet
out_of_scope.why: The acrylic band's place and fins are fixed architecture; only its light can change.
